note: P4382 (Pro 31:3) — do not give your strength to women, your ways to those who destroy kings.

dims.v: self-squandering lust — spending one's vigour on women, the ruin of kings

the giving of one's strength to women — the squandering of vigour and rule on sexual indulgence, the dissipation that has destroyed kings, a man's powers poured out on lust rather than kept for his calling
the vigour wasted on lust that has toppled kings

chayil (strength/vigour) — 'do not give your STRENGTH to women, your ways to those who destroy kings' (31:3); Lemuel's mother warns against squandering one's powers on lust. Sexual indulgence has been the ruin of kings — strength spent there is strength lost from the throne (cf 5:9-11; 7:26).
